ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (black) to 15% high-intensity (white) across the visible surface, with high-intensity pixels localized at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones at the left and right distal tips; the right tip contains a complex geometric overlay of dark linear patterns (rake marks) on the white background; central fluke body is solid black with sparse white point noise.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 85 degrees and a sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude (2-8 pixel) peaks and valleys spanning the entire horizontal width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upwards and outwards from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of approximately 6-10 circular white pixel clusters (scars) visible on the lower-central black surface of the lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly distinct parallel white linear disruptions located on the right distal lobe tip (rake marks); shorter, less dense parallel linear marks on the left distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring on the rightmost lobe tip; additional minor linear scarring on the left distal lobe edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'staircase' or 'ladder' scar pattern characterized by parallel horizontal white lines on the far right distal tip.
